domain: Environmental Monitoring - Indoor Laboratory IoT Sensor Network

columns.name: time
columns.description: Time of day with microsecond precision

columns.name: epoch
columns.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number per mote; same epoch from different motes indicates simultaneous readings

columns.name: moteid
columns.description: Unique identifier for sensor mote (node) in the network

columns.name: temperature
columns.description: Ambient temperature measured by the sensor

columns.name: light
columns.description: Light intensity; reference values: 1 Lux=moonlight, 400 Lux=bright office, 100,000 Lux=full sunlight

columns.name: voltage
columns.description: Battery voltage from lithium-ion cells; maintains fairly constant voltage with variations highly correlated to temperature

data_quality.sensor_accuracy: Some motes may have missing or truncated data; some epochs may be missing in the sequence
